title: Advanced Bongcloud
reviewNotes: Montage, captions and native later diagrams reviewed. Begin at 160 seconds after White Ke6 in the complete five-piece pawn ending: White Ke6 versus Black Kb4/a6/b5/c6, with Black to move. The next native diagram shows Kc3 and White Kd6 while the b-pawn is dragged forward. Every encoded position is exactly checked with the tablebase. Replies after the initial Kc3 are supplied as independent representative continuations, not a recovered complete game score: rapid play skips intermediate moves. The preceding nine-piece ending, rook-versus-knight phase, rook exchange and exact fast capture chronology remain outside this verification. No white pawn has been artificially removed from this later board.
